article.headline: Klaczek, Cuthrell lead Elon over Richmond 73-70
article.description: — Kacper Klaczek scored 16 points to help Elon fend off Richmond 73-70 on Wednesday night.
article.linkText: Klaczek, Cuthrell lead Elon over Richmond 73-70
article.story: ELON, N.C. -- — Kacper Klaczek scored 16 points to help Elon fend off Richmond 73-70 on Wednesday night. Chandler Cuthrell helped secure the victory with a layup with 53 seconds remaining. Klaczek also had six rebounds and three steals for the Phoenix (7-4). Ja'Juan Carr totaled 13 points and five rebounds. Isaac Harrell scored 11. AJ Lopez finished with 15 points and two blocks for the Spiders (9-2). Apostolos Roumoglou added 12 points, four assists and three steals. Jaden Daughtry added 10 points. Carr scored nine points in the first half and Elon went into halftime trailing 41-35. Klaczek scored a team-high 12 points in the second half to help the Phoenix earn the victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
